newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Materials mulls Thai copper tube plant.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Materials mulls Thai copper tube plant.

text.p: Mitsubishi Materials Corp said on Wednesday that it is considering building a plant in Thailand for the production of copper tubes.
The tubes will be mainly used for air conditioners, a company spokesman said.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Wednesday that the total investment in the project would be nearly 20 billion yen and the plant would start producing 1,000 tonnes of copper tubes per month from 1998.
Output would rise to 2,000 tonnes a month in the future, it said.
The Mitsubishi Materials spokesman declined to comment on the report, saying that the company needs to obtain the Thai government's approval before finalising the plan.
